sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球知名的大学，致力于解决当今世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境领域最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内合作创新，寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学旨在提升所有生物生活质量的使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu 了解更多信息。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是“99%无形”。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Our modern world is determined by them, the architects, the designers.
sentences.zh: 我们的现代世界由他们主宰，也就是建筑师和设计师。

sentences.en: They decide how you experience the physical world.
sentences.zh: 他们决定了你如何体验这个物质世界。

sentences.en: But the ubiquity of smartphones with GPS, a compass, a network, and more computing power than we know what to do with
sentences.zh: 然而，无处不在的智能手机配备了GPS、指南针、网络，以及超乎想象的强大计算能力，

sentences.en: has created this new space where a new reality can lie on top of the physical, real world.
sentences.zh: 创造出了这样一个新空间，一种全新的现实可以叠加在实体真实的世界上。

sentences.en: It's an augmented reality, and it adds a whole new level of creativity and design to the everyday world.
sentences.zh: 这是一种增强现实，它为日常生活增添了全新的创造力和设计维度。

sentences.en: Most augmented reality uses the smartphone's camera.
sentences.zh: 大多数增强现实技术都会使用智能手机的摄像头。

sentences.en: You turn on the application, you hit the augmented reality button, and then you look through your phone's camera
sentences.zh: 你打开应用程序，点击增强现实按钮，然后通过手机的摄像头去观察

sentences.en: at the now labeled and visible stars and planets in the daytime sky.
sentences.zh: 白天晴空中那些现在已被标注和显示的恒星与行星。

sentences.en: Or another app could pop up cool infographics with details about a bridge or a building.
sentences.zh: 或者另一个应用程序可能会弹出炫酷的信息图表，提供有关某座桥梁或建筑的详细信息。

sentences.en: It's still in its infancy, but the possibility of experiencing a hidden world on top of the world in front of you
sentences.zh: 它仍处于起步阶段，但在你眼前的世界之上体验一个隐藏世界的可能性

sentences.en: is tantalizing and so full of potential.
sentences.zh: 是如此诱人，且充满了无限潜力。

sentences.en: But I personally like to augment my reality with sound.
sentences.zh: 但我个人更喜欢用声音来增强我的现实。

sentences.en: And that brings us to the musical smartphone app called RJDJ.
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带到了那款名为 RJDJ 的音乐智能手机应用。

sentences.en: We're, you know, combining the world around you with your listening experience.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们在将你周围的世界与你的聆听体验结合起来。

sentences.en: That's the founder of RJDJ, Michael Breidenbrooker.
sentences.zh: 说话的是 RJDJ 的创始人迈克尔·布雷登布鲁克尔。
zh_words: 迈克尔·布雷登布鲁克尔

sentences.en: So, you know, the door closes and something really amazing acoustically could happen.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，门关上时，声学上可能会发生一些非常奇妙的事情。

sentences.en: Robert Thomas is one of RJDJ's composers.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·托马斯是 RJDJ 的作曲家之一。

sentences.en: RJDJ creates what we call reactive music, which is a new format of music which changes in relation to what you're doing.
sentences.zh: RJDJ 创造了我们所说的反应式音乐，这是一种根据你的行为而改变的全新音乐格式。

sentences.en: RJDJ is comprised of scenes, which are analogous to songs, but they're more like instructions for songs.
sentences.zh: RJDJ 由场景组成，这类似于歌曲，但它们更像是歌曲的指令。

sentences.en: There are bits of music, code for the phone's own built-in synthesizer, audio filters,
sentences.zh: 这里有一些音乐片段、手机内置合成器的代码、音频滤波器，

sentences.en: and these are triggered by the user according to the composer's plan for the scene.
sentences.zh: 这些都是根据作曲家对场景的设想由用户触发的。

sentences.en: I call this quantum composing.
sentences.zh: 我把这称为量子作曲。

sentences.en: You think of all these different possible ways that it could be listened to
sentences.zh: 你会考虑到所有可能倾听它的不同方式，

sentences.en: and try to come up with lots of different ways that that will create something very interesting to happen in the music.
sentences.zh: 并尝试想出各种不同的途径，让音乐中发生非常有趣的变化。

sentences.en: When a sound coming in from your surrounding is very loud,
sentences.zh: 当周围传来的声音非常嘈杂时，

sentences.en: you could have lots of really high notes kind of going doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo.
sentences.zh: 你可能会听到很多很高音调的旋律，像是嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟。

sentences.en: So sounds from the mic changed the song, but so does the accelerometer in the phone.
sentences.zh: 因此，麦克风收集的声音会改变歌曲，手机里的加速度计也是如此。

sentences.en: That's the thing that senses movement.
sentences.zh: 那是感应运动的部件。

sentences.en: Time spent listening can be a factor, and even GPS data can be incorporated.
sentences.zh: 聆听的时长可以是一个影响因素，甚至连 GPS 数据也可以融入其中。

sentences.en: And all these stimuli work in concert to create a unique, augmented reality.
sentences.zh: 所有这些刺激因素协同工作，创造出独特的增强现实。

sentences.en: And the way you experience your city will be altered from its basic form.
sentences.zh: 你体验城市的方式将从其基本形态发生改变。

sentences.en: I mean, you've walked around with music playing in your headphones
sentences.zh: 我是说，你肯定有过戴着耳机听着音乐走在街上的经历，

sentences.en: and felt those moments of musical synchronicity that changed how you saw and felt about your surroundings.
sentences.zh: 并感受到那些音乐同步的时刻，它们改变了你对周围环境的视觉和情感体验。

sentences.en: Well, imagine that times a thousand.
sentences.zh: 好吧，把那种感觉放大一千倍。

sentences.en: Right now, RJDJ is mainly ambient pop and structured noise, but imagine what it could be.
sentences.zh: 目前，RJDJ 的音乐主要以环境流行乐和结构化噪音为主，但想象一下它未来的无限可能。

sentences.en: The world will become a playground for interaction designers.
sentences.zh: 世界将成为交互设计师的游乐场。

sentences.en: It kind of feels like you're seeing some inner beauty in everything.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像你在万事万物中看到了某种内在的美。

sentences.en: You know, the most famous one that people get that from is a scene called Eargasm.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，人们最熟悉并从中体会到这点的一个场景叫作“高潮”（Eargasm）。

sentences.en: And this kind of harmonic overlay of a reality.
sentences.zh: 这也是对现实的一种和谐叠加。

sentences.en: This one's called Eargasm.
sentences.zh: 这个场景叫作“高潮”。

sentences.en: I had my wife, May, put on the patented white earbuds to check out one of the scenes for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我让我的妻子梅戴上那副获得专利的白色耳机，首次体验其中一个场景。

sentences.en: It's what a steel girder would hear, if a steel girder could hear.
sentences.zh: 如果钢梁能听到声音的话，这就是钢梁所听到的声音。

sentences.en: It's kind of like being in a horror movie, but not quite horrible.
sentences.zh: 这有点像置身于恐怖片中，但又不算太可怕。

sentences.en: Rather than putting on a set of headphones to block out the rest of the world,
sentences.zh: 与戴上耳机把世界隔绝在外的做法不同，

sentences.en: RJDJ listeners will plug into a constantly changing, unique soundscape
sentences.zh: RJDJ 的听众将接入一个不断变化、独一无二的声景，

sentences.en: that connects them to what they are doing and where they are in the world.
sentences.zh: 将他们与自己正在做的事情以及所处的地理位置紧密相连。

sentences.en: I imagine walking around San Francisco, listening to a mashed up composition of punk and hip-hop
sentences.zh: 我幻想着在旧金山漫步，听着一首将朋克与嘻哈混搭的音乐作品，

sentences.en: that gives me a history of the neighborhood I'm traveling through.
sentences.zh: 它向我讲述我所穿行的这个街区的历史。

sentences.en: And the GPS will trigger a sound clip from Alfred Hitchcock's Vertigo when I pass through Knob Hill.
sentences.zh: 当我穿过诺布山时，GPS 会触发一段来自阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克电影《迷魂记》的音效剪辑。

sentences.en: Have you had any dizzy spells this week?
sentences.zh: 你这周有过头晕的症状吗？

sentences.en: I'm having one right now.
sentences.zh: 我正经历着呢。

sentences.en: It's the music.
sentences.zh: 全因这音乐。

sentences.en: And the tempo will speed up as I scurry out of the way of an obnoxious bike messenger
sentences.zh: 当我急忙躲开一个讨人厌的送餐骑手，却差点撞上一辆迎面驶来且未曾察觉的缆车时，节奏也会随之加快。

sentences.en: into the path of an unnoticed oncoming cable car.
sentences.zh: 当我倒在路面上突然一动不动时，

sentences.en: My sudden lack of all movement as I lie on the pavement
sentences.zh: iPhone 耳机将发出令人愉悦的和谐嗡鸣声，

sentences.en: will elicit a pleasing harmonic drone from the iPhone earbuds,
sentences.zh: 它将与逼近的救护车警笛声完美交织在一起。

sentences.en: which will mix beautifully with the sirens from the paramedics as they approach.
sentences.zh: 停！

sentences.en: Stop!
sentences.zh: “99%无形”由我罗曼·马尔斯制作，并得到了 Lunar 的支持。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is produced by me, Roman Mars, with support from Lunar.
sentences.zh: 这是 KALW、美国建筑师学会旧金山分会以及建筑与设计中心的合作项目。

sentences.en: It's a project of KALW, the American Institute of Architects San Francisco,
sentences.zh: 这是一个合作项目。

sentences.en: and the Center for Architecture and Design.
sentences.zh: 建筑与设计中心联合呈现。
